name: Chio architecture summary
source_description: Curated seed for agent orientation in the Chio repository.

body.summary: Chio is a secure, attested tool access protocol. Agents are untrusted. The runtime kernel validates time-bounded capability tokens, runs guard and policy evaluation before tool calls cross trust boundaries, and signs append-only receipt records.
editing_guidance: Start with protocol and core type contracts before changing kernel behavior.
Use kb_brief_feature for major work because it combines code, docs, tests, graph impact, memory, and validation commands.
Repo files and current CI remain authoritative. The graph is retrieval support only.
